test_title: PYST 41: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north. No one sits to the left of G. Only four people sit between G and A. Only three people sit to the right of E. D sits to the immediate left of F. B is not an immediate neighbour of E. How many people sit to the right of C?
solution:
Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing north.

1) No one sits to the left of G.

2) Only four people sit between G and A.

3) Only three people sit to the right of E.

4) D sits to the immediate left of F.

5) B is not an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f8d5d6664dc1d285a88fee53c00cc4d5044c6989cf89bb712bf918a5bcaf852.png] 

So, 2 people sit to the right of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
